android.desc:
MISTIS 

Advanced user authentication

The Problem We Solve

You receive a call from someone claiming to be your bank, your family member, or a trusted colleague. The number looks right. The voice sounds exactly the same. Everything looks fine to go into delicate information exchange; but, in fact, it’s an AI-generated voice at the other side, taking over the legitimate identity of the speaker.

Phone scams, caller ID spoofing, and voice deepfakes are increasingly everywhere. Fraudsters can fake phone numbers, manipulate their voices real-time, and convince you they're someone you trust.

MISTIS provides the certainty required to absolutely trust who you are speaking with.

AI models can recognise other AI’s (or humans) with a certain degree of certainty. We deliver final and direct user authentication without using AI. 

We base our authentication mechanisms on the same rails credit card transactions authenticate. No AI model would be able to deliver the same result to an absolute precision.

---

How does the app work?

MISTIS is a smartphone app that lets you verify the identity of people calling you – in real-time, during the call. You will also likely be asked to verify your identity.

No more wondering. No more falling for scams. Just instant proof of who's on the other end of the line with no space for guessing or likelihoods.

---

How MISTIS Works 

1. Download & register

Install MISTIS on your smartphone, subscribe and create your secure account.

2. Pair with your contacts

Exchange a one-time verification code with the people you trust (family, colleagues, business partners). You only do this once with each of your contact you want to establish secure calls with.

3. Make or receive calls and get instant authentication
 
Use your phone normally. When you call or receive a call from someone in your MISTIS network, the app automatically works in the background.

4. Get Instant Authentication

During the call, MISTIS confirms yours and the other person's identity. You see a verified badge on your screen – proof that the person on the line is who they claim to be.

5. Request an identity verification anytime (Push Challenge)

show_hn.title: Show HN: Mistis – a decoupled, E2EE protocol for mid-call user authentication

quotes.text:
We have built an authentication protocol enabling mid-session real-time identity verification between final users during any active communication, delivered via a proprietary decoupled channel.

System allows users to send identity verification challenges to each other on-demand during communication. The goal is to prevent identity takeover by real-time audio deepfakes.

It is inspired in 3DS credit card processing –taking away the UX nightmare; some similarities: decoupled rail for authentication, enrolment, user redirection to trusted authentication mechanism.

The method is based on cryptographic credential management, employing only open standards via a proprietary algorithm. The server relays messages and serves for message-hardening enforcement.

Cryptographic operations, source of truth and decisions are all on the client-side. The model could be considered P2P in essence and usability –despite the existence of a limited-role server as a minimal required infrastructure. Our servers do not process or store any PII.

Our first use case is applied to regular carrier mobile phone calls, and requires installing a mobile app to function. Also, the protocol can be applied and integrated into any communication.

It would be great if you’d like to have a look at it and let us know what you think. I will be here to discuss online.

You can download the app and test it (limited testers):

- Android link: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mistis.authentication
